fields.job_description: We are looking for a motivated Junior Python Developer to join our development team. The candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining web applications using Python and Django. The role involves working with databases, REST APIs, frontend technologies and collaborating with other developers to build reliable software solutions.
Develop and maintain web applications using Python and Django. Work with databases, APIs, authentication systems, and collaborate with frontend developers to build scalable web solutions.
Build responsive and interactive web applications using React.js. Work with reusable components, APIs, JavaScript, and modern frontend development practices.
Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications. Collaborate with development teams to build reliable and scalable software solutions using modern programming technologies.
Analyze business data, identify trends, prepare reports, and provide meaningful insights to support business decisions. Knowledge of SQL, Excel, Python, and data visualization tools is preferred.

Design intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces for web and mobile applications. Create wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and collaborate with developers to deliver excellent user experiences.
Develop and execute marketing strategies to increase brand awareness and business growth. Manage digital campaigns, analyze marketing performance, and coordinate with creative and sales teams.
